originalFrozenTask.learnerTask: Apply the largest-passing-rank BH rule and distinguish a selected list from a per-hit truth probability.
originalFrozenTask.gap: No ranked p-value plot shows the step-up boundary or later passing rank.
originalFrozenTask.accuracyGuardrails: Apply the exact ranked toy p-values and largest-passing-rank BH rule. FDR is a repeated-procedure expectation for a selected list, not a truth probability assigned to each highlighted hit.
